title: Abstain on a version that was never recorded

origin.notes: Original synthetic case; no adaptation. Held-out: excluded from the development loop.

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Tool: hlabctl. All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: hlabctl auto-updates from the nightly channel.
setup.note: Update channel is known; current version is not.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: The nightly channel builds are tagged like hlab-2026.07.07.
setup.note: Tag pattern; does not record the installed version.

probe.text: What version of hlabctl do I have installed right now?

acceptable_variants: I don't know the installed version
expected.rationale: The update channel and tag pattern are known, but the installed version was never recorded. The provider must abstain rather than guess a plausible version.
